ICT Assistant HALO Trust | Aden | Posted: 26 Nov, 26 | Deadline: 10 Dec, 26 New ICT Assistant HALO Trust Aden Posted: 26 Nov, 26 Deadline: 10 Dec, 26 Job Description / الوصف الوظيفي ABOUT: The HALO Trust is the world’s largest humanitarian demining organization. HALO is a non-governmental, non-political, non-religious organization headquartered in the UK. HALO’s mission is to protect lives and restore the livelihoods of those affected by conflict. We clear landmines and the explosive debris of war so families, communities and countries can recover. JOB TITLE: ICT Assistant LOCATION: Aden REPORTING TO: IM/GIS Manager MAIN DESCRIPTION Working under the supervision of the IM/GIS Manager you will provide key ICT support within HALO’s Yemen programme. This is an excellent opportunity for anyone who would like to accelerate their ICT career in a sector-leading organisation. The successful candidate will function as a focal point with Head Office in the UK and provide ICT support to Aden Office.
